provenance.paper_title: Dream to Recall: Imagination-Guided Experience Retrieval for Memory-Persistent Vision-and-Language Navigation

evidence.paraphrase: Previous episodes populate history and observation memory banks. imagination generates queries to retrieve observation/history memories.

evidence.section: Full paper: B. Hybrid Viewpoint-Level Memory (HVM)
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, Dream to Recall / Memoir applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to episodic / trajectory memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (episodic / trajectory memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
